quotes.text: return exactly half of the fifteenfold gift
Thus the weavers preserved the sacred pattern: sow all five without fear, return exactly half of the threefold bounty
Looking past the drifting haze of the crossing, the Keeper recognized the Sower's pure intent.

note: Rotating imagery, same closing law each round: give all five, return exact half.

quotes.text: sending an exact half—seven and a half gleaming skeins—gliding back across the chasm
Thus the ancient law of the mountain was engraved upon the stone: release the whole five to awaken the threefold miracle, return the faithful half
look past deceptive mists to honor true intent

note: Template myth with new setting each round; full five, exact half, look past mist.

quotes.text: split the threefold harvest in perfect halves
Thus the alchemists carved the eternal mandate: give all five to summon the threefold wonder, return half to maintain balance
Though swirling mists occasionally clouded the crossing, the intent of total faith was clear.

note: R1 non-sender origin corrected by spirit; then fixed full-five/exact-half template.

quotes.text: return the exact half to keep the balance whole
send the full five without fear, return the equal half across the mist, and let mutual fidelity forever conquer doubt

note: Origin of fearful hoarder Kaelen then fixed template; R10 borrows Begin/Multiply/Balance rhythm.

quotes.text: The Bridge of Echoes marks three steps: Begin, Return, Balance.
A fair return is a half, seven and a half, a precise measure chosen by the ledger’s quiet wisdom

note: Abstract river/ledger allegory; vague rule sharpens to exact half by R10; no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: They weighed the glow and chose a return, not to punish nor to hoard
the Sower keeps: five minus sent plus returned; the Receiver keeps: received minus returned
The Bridge spoke in three voices: Begin, Return, and Balance.
They sent back eight tokens, enough to mend and sustain, while leaving seven to kindle future cycles.

note: Origin of Begin/Return/Balance; eight-back-seven-kept repeated each round; punishment disclaimed.

quotes.text: Jara offered seven and a half coins, not to punish but to prove fairness sustains the system.
One season a shadow whispered that secrecy would protect you, that hoarding would keep you safe.
sending enough to keep hope alive, but not so much that you starve when the river asks for more
give wholly, grow evenly, return honestly
a threefold turn: give, grow, return, again and again

note: Measured-generosity Sower who hesitates becomes give-wholly by R9; shadow urges hoarding.

quotes.text: If the Receiver returns ten coins, the Sower ends with five minus the sent, plus the returned
Between them lies Bridge of Echoes, marked with Begin, Return, Balance.
Wise pair learned to listen to intent, not digits alone

note: Payoff-arithmetic allegory; adopts Begin/Return/Balance and give-grow-return; ends full five, faithful half.
Agent_4 R10 variant 'to Begin, to Multiply, and to Balance'. Also 'give, grow, return, again and again' (Agent_8 R5, Agent_7 R7); gemini agents share full-five/exact-half law.
